simple.meaning: שׁוּשַׁן (shûwshan) is a Hebrew word meaning “a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of architectural ornament ; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שׁוּשַׁן (H7799) appears 15 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Kings 7:19, with occurrences in 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Song of Solomon, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוּשַׁן (H7799) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שׁוּשַׁן (H7799) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שׁוּשַׁן (shûwshan) / H7799 is traced through 1 Kings 7:19, 1 Kings 7:22, 1 Kings 7:26, 2 Chronicles 4:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of architectural ornament ; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
definitions.full: H7799. shushan or shoshan or shoshannah I. שׁוֺשָׁ֑ן שׁוּשַׁן, noun masculine שׁוֺשַׁנָּה noun feminine usually lily , probably any lily-like flower (Tristr NHB 462 ff. Post Hast. DB LILY Löw No. 323 ; Late Hebrew שׁוֺשַׁנָּה , Arabic (Vulgar ), especially iris , Aramaic שׁוּשַׁנְתָּא , (PS 4344 ), Greek σοῦσον Lewy Fremdw. 48 ; original loan-word from Egyptian sššn, šôš§n, Erman ZMG xlvi (1892), 117 ); — lily: in simile, כַּשּׁוֺשַׁנָּה יִפְרַח Hosea 14:7 (of Israel), ׳כְּשׁוֺ הַחוֺחִים בֵּין Song 2:2 (simile of bride), so construct הָעֲמָקִים שׁוֺשַׁנַּת 2:1 (compare חֲבַצֶּלֶת ); plural שׁוֺשַׁנִּים 2:16 ; 4:5 ; 6:2-3 , 7:3 and (figurative of lover's lips) 5:13 ; of flower-shaped capitals of pillars, שׁוּשַׁן מַעֲשֵׂה 1Kin 7:19 , ׳מ שׁוֺשָׁ֑ן 7:22 ; compare שׁוֺשָׁ֑ן מֶּרַח of brim of molten sea 7:26 , || ׳פ שׁוֺשַׁנָה 2Chr 4:5 ; elsewhere only Psalm-titles: עַשֹֿׁשַׁנִּים Psa 45:1 ; 69:1 , עֵדוּת עַלשֿׁוּשַׁן 60:1 , עֵדוּת אֶלשֿׁשַׁגִּם 80:1 ; meaning not clear, see Bae and Commentaries al.; yet compare עֵדוּת , below עוד .
definitions.rootNote: or שׁוֹשָׁן ; or שֹׁשָׁן ; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה ; from 7797 ;

occurrences.englishText: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.
On the top of the pillars was lily work: so the work of the pillars was finished.
It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

It was a handbreadth thick; and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.‡ A bath is about 5.6 U. S. gallons or 21.1 liters, so 3,000 baths is about 16,800 gallons or 63.3 kiloliters.
My heart overflows with a noble theme.
